NEEDS.
Copy. Paste. Swap the [brackets]. Swipe ▸

cards.p: Someone asked what brakes cost on a [year make model]. Reply: my range [range], what changes it, two open times.
Turn my estimate [paste] into a plain text for the customer: each part, labor, total, what can wait.
Sort my tech's notes [paste] into fix now and can wait, as written. Plain words, no scare words.
I sent [name] an estimate [days] days ago and heard nothing. Write one short, friendly follow up, no pressure.
Write a pickup text for [name]: car is ready, total [amount], our hours [hours], what we fixed in one line.
The part for [name]'s car is delayed until [date]. Write an honest update text and offer [ride or loaner].
We found [issue] while doing [job]. Write a text asking [name] to approve or skip it, price [price].
Write my after hours drop off steps: key box [where], form [link], what to leave in the car.
Turn my messy notes [paste] into a clean work order: complaint, cause, fix, parts, labor hours.
Plan tomorrow for [number] bays and [number] techs from these jobs and times [paste]. List by bay.
From these jobs [paste], list every part I need to order, grouped by supplier [suppliers], with quantities.
Explain this repair in 3 short sentences to someone who knows nothing about cars: [repair and notes].
Reply to this 1 star review about a slow repair: [paste]. Own the delay, explain, invite them to call [number].
A review says we overcharged: [paste]. Write a calm public reply showing what we did. No arguing, under 60 words.
Write a short text for after pickup asking [name] for a Google review with my link [link]. No pressure.
Read these reviews [paste]. List the 3 things customers complain about most and one fix for each.
Here is today's job photo: [describe]. Write 5 posts for this week from it, one tip each, plain words.
Write a post reminding locals to check [tires, battery, wipers] before [season]. Friendly, under 80 words, link [link].
Write a short post on what [warning light] can mean and why to get it checked. Calm, no scare words.
Write a post introducing [tech name]: years fixing cars [years], favorite job [job], one fun fact [fact].
[Name] picked up their car but still owes [amount] from [date]. Write a polite reminder with my pay link [link].
Sort these receipts into parts, tools, shop supplies, rent, other: [paste]. Total each, flag any missing a date.
My monthly costs are [rent, wages, tools] and we bill [hours] hours a month. Show what each hour costs me.
Write my payment policy in plain words: pay at pickup, we take [methods], deposit [amount] on special orders.
